name: Artemis II
about: Artemis II (2026-069A), a crewed vehicle (Artemis), launched 2026 Apr  1. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (DSO).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2026 Apr  2), held fixed
